_comment: 14 visual identities for 9:16 explainers. Hex values are design proposals; contrast ratios were computed with the WCAG relative-luminance formula (tests/test_scripts.py re-checks them). 'text_safe' maps an accent to a variant that meets 4.5:1 as TEXT on the background named in text_safe_on; accents that fail as text are for fills only. Fonts: OFL unless noted (checked against google/fonts METADATA.pb on 2026-10-20). 'no_tabular' lists fonts whose files have no tabular figures: animate numbers in numbers_font instead. Palettes are original to this skill; no studio's brand assets are claimed.

editorial-serif.name: Editorial serif (salmon paper)
editorial-serif.register: explanatory journalism, economics, history, policy: trust and calm

texture.extras: 6px ink rule above the kicker; hairline rules between blocks

traps: low-chroma palette plus thin serif strokes compress badly: keep the hero at 140 px or larger
Fraunces has no tabular figures

ai_art_style.medium: editorial illustration, flat colour shapes on warm newsprint paper
ai_art_style.lighting: soft even daylight, no hard shadows
ai_art_style.texture: fine paper grain, slight ink spread
ai_art_style.color_grading: warm cream, claret and oxford blue, low saturation
ai_art_style.signature_technique: restrained spot colour with one claret highlight

newsroom.name: Newsroom / broadcast
newsroom.register: breaking and current affairs: authority and speed

texture.extras: vertical gradient plate; red kicker tag (white on #E10600 is 4.97:1); red rule above the source line

motion.cuts: angled wipes at about 15 degrees and hard cuts
motion.camera: lower-third bar slides in, text lags 0.1 s

traps: red #E10600 as text on navy is 3.33:1: use it as a fill with white text or text-safe #FF4B45
condensed type is for headlines only

ai_art_style.medium: clean documentary photograph look, neutral colour, broadcast news cutaway
ai_art_style.color_grading: cool navy shadows, neutral skin, restrained saturation

creator-shorts.name: Creator / shorts caption style
creator-shorts.register: hosted and talking-head shorts, fast opinion, word-pop captions

texture.extras: soft radial gradient; legibility comes from a 7-8% stroke (-webkit-text-stroke with paint-order: stroke fill) plus a hard shadow

traps: a heavy stroke over a 3-line hero eats vertical budget: two lines maximum
captions must stay inside the platform safe box: the bottom 480 px is UI

ai_art_style.medium: punchy sticker-style graphic on a dark gradient
ai_art_style.color_grading: saturated yellow, hot pink, mint on charcoal
ai_art_style.signature_technique: thick black outline on every foreground shape

tech-terminal.name: Tech / terminal

texture.extras: repeating-linear-gradient scanlines at 3.5% white; 90 px blue grid at 7%; subtle text glow; block cursor; kicker prefixed '$ '

motion.cuts: hard cuts, glitch of 3 to 5 frames sparingly

traps: neon on black glares at large sizes: keep the glow subtle
scanlines can alias after compression

ai_art_style.medium: dark UI and terminal aesthetic, vector grid, monospaced details
ai_art_style.color_grading: near-black with green and cyan accents
ai_art_style.signature_technique: thin glowing lines on a dark grid

blueprint.name: Blueprint / technical drawing

texture.extras: two-level grid: 240 px major at 16% white, 48 px minor at 7%; hatch fills; title-block label in yellow

traps: thin lines must stay 3 to 4 px at 1080 wide to survive recompression
the minor grid must stay behind text

ai_art_style.medium: technical blueprint drawing, white and cyan linework on deep blue
ai_art_style.color_grading: monochrome blue with a single yellow annotation colour
ai_art_style.signature_technique: orthographic line drawing with dimension lines

paper-collage.name: Paper collage / cut-out
paper-collage.register: human stories, culture, history, food: warm and tactile

texture.extras: torn paper edges via clip-path on a background shape, cards rotated about -2 degrees, hard offset drop shadow

motion.overshoot: rotation of plus or minus 3 degrees
motion.cuts: paper wipes, no smooth camera moves

traps: clip-path on a bar also clips its absolutely positioned labels: clip a background shape, not the element holding labels
tomato #E4572E text is 2.2:1 on kraft: use ink, or text-safe #B8401B

ai_art_style.medium: 2.5D layered paper collage with torn rims, sticker borders and visible fibres
ai_art_style.lighting: soft overhead light with layered paper shadows
ai_art_style.color_grading: limited palette of kraft, cream, tomato red, teal and mustard
ai_art_style.signature_technique: contour-cut subjects as separate paper pieces with white sticker borders

halftone-pop.name: Halftone / pop-print

texture.extras: red dot field radial-gradient 36 px, masked diagonally so dots fade; 10 px black borders

motion.camera: dot field pulses 1.0 to 1.06 on hits

traps: white on halftone red is 4.42:1: use #C81D25 or black text on red
keep the dot mask away from the text column

ai_art_style.medium: pop-art comic print with halftone dots and thick ink outlines
ai_art_style.color_grading: cream paper with red, blue and yellow

risograph.name: Risograph
risograph.register: culture, art, independent-press feel, human-scale data

texture.extras: ink layers overprint with mix-blend-mode multiply; misregistration of 6 to 10 px between inks; at most 3 inks

motion.camera: 1 to 2 px jitter at 12 fps; misregistration settles from 14 px to 8 px

traps: pink #FF48B0 (2.69:1) and yellow #FFE800 (1.09:1) are never text
multiply blending makes dark on dark disappear

ai_art_style.medium: two and three colour risograph print on uncoated paper
ai_art_style.color_grading: blue, fluorescent pink and yellow on off-white

flat-vector.name: Flat vector explainer

texture.extras: star-field dots; flat shapes with one two-tone shade (inset shadow); rounded tops; no outlines

motion.camera: parallax star drift 2 to 4% per second; objects persist and morph

traps: red #E30050 text on navy is 3.84:1: text-safe #FF4D88
plain shapes alone drift toward generic: illustration quality carries this look

ai_art_style.medium: flat vector illustration with rounded shapes and a single two-tone shade
ai_art_style.color_grading: deep indigo background with yellow, magenta and orange accents
ai_art_style.signature_technique: no outlines, one darker tone for form

glass-keynote.name: Glassmorphism (keynote)
glass-keynote.register: product, fintech, premium consumer tech, UI-led explainers

texture.extras: mesh background of radial blobs; panels rgba(255,255,255,.14) with backdrop-filter blur 36px; 2 px translucent border; text-protection tint 0.5 to 0.6 when the blob behind can be bright

traps: white text on the .38 tint is 2.47:1 over white: raise the tint to 0.5 to 0.6
large backdrop-filter blur is GPU-heavy per frame

ai_art_style.medium: soft 3D glass and frosted translucent panels over a gradient mesh
ai_art_style.lighting: diffuse studio light with glowing edges

neo-brutalist.name: Neo-brutalist

texture.extras: 10 px black borders, hard offset shadows (24 px on cards, 14 px on bars), hero block tilted about -1.5 degrees

motion.overshoot: rotation within plus or minus 2 degrees

traps: coral and blue as text on cream are 2.7 and 2.9:1: use them as fills with black text
yellow with cyan pairings can fail readability

ai_art_style.medium: bold flat graphic with thick black outlines and hard offset shadows
ai_art_style.color_grading: primary yellow, coral and blue on cream

swiss-grid.name: Swiss grid / International style
swiss-grid.register: authority without drama, data-led, design-literate audiences

texture.extras: strict left alignment on a grid; a solid red circle; 12 px black top rule over the kicker; 8 px black baseline

traps: red #E3000F text on #F2F2F0 is 4.4:1: text-safe #D1001C
the look dies if anything is off-grid: lint alignment

ai_art_style.medium: Swiss poster design, geometric shapes and a strict grid, photographic cut-outs
ai_art_style.color_grading: off-white, black and one signal red

dark-luxe.name: Dark luxe / cinematic
dark-luxe.register: premium product, finance as lifestyle, documentary-style narration

texture.extras: radial vignette; 2 px gold inset frame at 55% alpha about 90 px from the edge (inset more on TikTok's right rail); optional letterbox

motion.camera: 1 to 3% push; letter-spacing tightens from .12em to 0

traps: hairline serifs vanish when compressed: hero 140 px or larger
deep red #7A1F2B is decoration only (1.9:1 as text)

ai_art_style.medium: low-key cinematic still life, dark background with warm gold highlights
ai_art_style.color_grading: black, antique gold, restrained deep red

whiteboard-doodle.name: Whiteboard / notebook doodle

texture.extras: 72 px paper grid; wavy red underline; slightly irregular rounded corners

motion.camera: static; strokes appear in the order the voice says them

traps: red #E63946 text is 4.0:1 (large only): text-safe #CC2F3B
handwriting fonts are hard to read below about 56 px

ai_art_style.medium: hand-drawn marker doodles on a notebook grid
ai_art_style.color_grading: navy marker with red, green and orange accents on white
